<p>The text a page shows is often made in its PHP first: a title cut to fit a card, a column
name turned into a label, a slug for a database column, a token for a mail. PHP's own
<code>substr</code> and <code>ucwords</code> count bytes and know only ASCII; the
<code>padStr</code> functions count characters, so an accented letter or an emoji is never
cut in half. They are plain functions, loaded on every request like the rest of
<code>pad/lib/</code>.</p>

<table border="1" cellpadding="8" cellspacing="0" style="border-collapse: collapse;">
  <tr>
    <th>function</th>
    <th>what it answers</th>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><code>padStrLimit ( $text, $limit = 100, $end = '...' )</code></td>
    <td>at most <code>$limit</code> characters, <code>$end</code> added when something was cut</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><code>padStrWords ( $text, $words = 100, $end = '...' )</code></td>
    <td>at most <code>$words</code> words</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><code>padStrExcerpt ( $text, $phrase, $radius = 100, $omission = '...' )</code></td>
    <td>the phrase with <code>$radius</code> characters on either side, found case-insensitively</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><code>padStrSquish ( $text )</code></td>
    <td>trimmed, every run of whitespace one space</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><code>padStrCamel</code>, <code>padStrStudly</code>, <code>padStrSnake ( $text, $delimiter = '_' )</code>, <code>padStrKebab</code>, <code>padStrHeadline</code></td>
    <td>userName, UserName, user_name, user-name, User Name - from a name in any of those cases</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><code>padStrTitle ( $text )</code></td>
    <td>every word with a capital</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><code>padStrSlug ( $text, $separator = '-' )</code></td>
    <td>a readable URL part - what the <code>slug</code> pipe gives</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><code>padStrAfter</code>, <code>padStrAfterLast</code>, <code>padStrBefore</code>, <code>padStrBeforeLast ( $text, $search )</code></td>
    <td>the text after or before the first or last occurrence - what the pipes of those names give</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><code>padStrBetween ( $text, $from, $to )</code></td>
    <td>what stands between the first <code>$from</code> and the last <code>$to</code></td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><code>padStrIs ( $pattern, $value )</code></td>
    <td>whether the value matches a pattern with <code>*</code> wildcards, or one of a list</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><code>padStrMask ( $text, $character, $index, $length = NULL )</code></td>
    <td>a stretch of the text replaced by one character</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><code>padStrPlural ( $word, $count = 2 )</code>, <code>padStrSingular ( $word )</code></td>
    <td>the English plural or singular of a word</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><code>padStrRandom ( $length = 16 )</code></td>
    <td>random letters and digits</td>
  </tr>
  <tr>
    <td><code>padStrUuid ( $version = 4 )</code></td>
    <td>a version 4 (random) or version 7 (time-ordered) UUID</td>
  </tr>
</table>

<h2>Shortening text</h2>

<p><code>padStrLimit</code> cuts at a number of characters and <code>padStrWords</code> at a
number of words; both trim the space the cut leaves, add <code>$end</code> only when something
was cut, and give a text that fits back as it is. <code>padStrExcerpt</code> is the snippet of
a search result: the place the phrase stands, with the text around it.
<code>padStrSquish</code> makes text pasted into a form field compare and store the same way,
tabs, newlines and no-break spaces included.</p>

<h2>Names in every case</h2>

<p>The case functions read the words of a name whatever case it is in - an underscore, a
dash, a space or a change of case separates them - and write them in the case asked for, so
<code>created_at</code>, <code>createdAt</code> and <code>CreatedAt</code> all turn into each
other. <code>padStrHeadline</code> makes a label of a column name; <code>padStrTitle</code>
recases a sentence and leaves the rest of it as it is.</p>

<h2>Slugs and cutting at a marker</h2>

<p><code>padStrSlug</code> is the <code>slug</code> pipe - the pipe calls it - so a slug
stored when a post is saved is the slug a template makes for its link. The same holds for
<code>after</code>, <code>afterLast</code>, <code>before</code> and <code>beforeLast</code>: a
text without the search string comes back unchanged. <code>padStrBetween</code> takes what
follows the first <code>$from</code> up to the last <code>$to</code>.</p>

<h2>Patterns and masks</h2>

<p><code>padStrIs</code> matches a value against a pattern in which <code>*</code> stands
for any run of characters - a list of patterns matches when one of them does - without
writing a regular expression. <code>padStrMask</code> hides part of a text: a negative index
counts from the end, a negative length stops that many characters before it.</p>

          </th>

          </th>
        
      </tr>
    

    <tr>
      
        <td style="vertical-align:top"><pre><code style="color: #000000"><span style="color: #0000BB">&lt;?php<br><br>  $allowed </span><span style="color: #007700">= [ </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'admin/*'</span><span style="color: #007700">, </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'reports/*.pdf' </span><span style="color: #007700">];<br><br>  </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$paths </span><span style="color: #007700">= [ </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'admin/users'</span><span style="color: #007700">,<br>             </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'reports/may.pdf'</span><span style="color: #007700">,<br>             </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'reports/may.csv' </span><span style="color: #007700">];<br><br>  </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$checks </span><span style="color: #007700">= [];<br><br>  foreach ( </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$paths </span><span style="color: #007700">as </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$path </span><span style="color: #007700">)<br>    </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$checks </span><span style="color: #007700">[] = [<br>      </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'path'    </span><span style="color: #007700">=&gt; </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$path</span><span style="color: #007700">,<br>      </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'allowed' </span><span style="color: #007700">=&gt; </span><span style="color: #0000BB">padStrIs </span><span style="color: #007700">( </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$allowed</span><span style="color: #007700">, </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$path </span><span style="color: #007700">) ? </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'yes' </span><span style="color: #007700">: </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'no'<br>    </span><span style="color: #007700">];<br><br>  </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$card  </span><span style="color: #007700">= </span><span style="color: #0000BB">padStrMask </span><span style="color: #007700">( </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'4111 1111 1111 1234'</span><span style="color: #007700">, </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'*'</span><span style="color: #007700">, </span><span style="color: #0000BB">0</span><span style="color: #007700">, -</span><span style="color: #0000BB">4 </span><span style="color: #007700">);<br>  </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$email </span><span style="color: #007700">= </span><span style="color: #0000BB">padStrMask </span><span style="color: #007700">( </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'ann.smith@example.com'</span><span style="color: #007700">, </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'*'</span><span style="color: #007700">, </span><span style="color: #0000BB">1</span><span style="color: #007700">, </span><span style="color: #0000BB">8 </span><span style="color: #007700">);<br><br></span><span style="color: #0000BB">?&gt;<br></span></code></pre> </td>
      
      
        <td style="vertical-align:top"><a class="pad-play" href="/pad/wasm/#" title="Try it in WASM" aria-label="Try this example in WASM"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="pad-icon pad-icon-play" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7Z"/></svg></a><a class="pad-play pad-live" href="/pad/live/#" title="Run it live, as a page of this server" aria-label="Run this example as a page of this server"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="pad-icon pad-icon-zap" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M13.5 2.5L5 13.5h6.5l-1 8 8.5-11h-6.5Z"/></svg></a><pre><code style="color: #000000"><b>{<font color="blue"><font color="purple">array</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>checks</font><font color="red"></font>}</b><br>  &lt;p&gt;<b>{<font color="green"><font color="red">$</font>path</font>}</b>: <b>{<font color="green"><font color="red">$</font>allowed</font>}</b>&lt;/p&gt;<br><b>{/<font color="blue"><font color="purple">array</font><font color="black"><b>:</b></font>checks</font><font color="red"></font>}</b><br>&lt;p&gt;<b>{<font color="green"><font color="red">$</font>card</font>}</b>&lt;/p&gt;<br>&lt;p&gt;<b>{<font color="green"><font color="red">$</font>email</font>}</b>&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre></td>
      
      
        <td style="vertical-align:top">
  
  <p>admin/users: yes</p>

  <p>reports/may.pdf: yes</p>

  <p>reports/may.csv: no</p>

<p>***************1234</p>
<p>a********@example.com</p>

<h2>Plural and singular</h2>

<p><code>padStrPlural</code> gives the English plural of the last word of a text: the
irregular words (person, child, mouse, knife ...), the uncountable ones (sheep, information,
equipment ...) and the rules for -y, -s, -x, -ch and the rest. A count of one keeps the word,
so <code>"$n " . padStrPlural ( 'file', $n )</code> reads right for every number; an array
or a Countable counts as its size. The case of the word is kept: Person, People;
PERSON, PEOPLE. <code>padStrSingular</code> goes the other way.</p>

      <tr>
        
          <th bgcolor="#dddddd">

            HTML

          </th>
        
        
          <th bgcolor="#dddddd">
            Result
            
          </th>
        
      </tr>
    

    <tr>
      
        <td style="vertical-align:top"><pre><code style="color: #000000"><span style="color: #0000BB">&lt;?php<br><br>  $carts </span><span style="color: #007700">= [];<br><br>  foreach ( [ </span><span style="color: #0000BB">0</span><span style="color: #007700">, </span><span style="color: #0000BB">1</span><span style="color: #007700">, </span><span style="color: #0000BB">2 </span><span style="color: #007700">] as </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$n </span><span style="color: #007700">)<br>    </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$carts </span><span style="color: #007700">[] = [<br>      </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'n'      </span><span style="color: #007700">=&gt; </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$n</span><span style="color: #007700">,<br>      </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'items'  </span><span style="color: #007700">=&gt; </span><span style="color: #0000BB">padStrPlural </span><span style="color: #007700">( </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'item'</span><span style="color: #007700">,   </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$n </span><span style="color: #007700">),<br>      </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'people' </span><span style="color: #007700">=&gt; </span><span style="color: #0000BB">padStrPlural </span><span style="color: #007700">( </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'person'</span><span style="color: #007700">, </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$n </span><span style="color: #007700">)<br>    ];<br><br>  </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$nouns </span><span style="color: #007700">= [ </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'city'</span><span style="color: #007700">, </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'child'</span><span style="color: #007700">, </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'knife'</span><span style="color: #007700">, </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'analysis'</span><span style="color: #007700">,<br>             </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'sheep'</span><span style="color: #007700">, </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'Person'</span><span style="color: #007700">, </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'blogPost' </span><span style="color: #007700">];<br><br>  </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$words </span><span style="color: #007700">= [];<br><br>  foreach ( </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$nouns </span><span style="color: #007700">as </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$word </span><span style="color: #007700">)<br>    </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$words </span><span style="color: #007700">[] = [<br>      </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'word'   </span><span style="color: #007700">=&gt; </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$word</span><span style="color: #007700">,<br>      </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'plural' </span><span style="color: #007700">=&gt; </span><span style="color: #0000BB">padStrPlural </span><span style="color: #007700">( </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$word </span><span style="color: #007700">),<br>      </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'back'   </span><span style="color: #007700">=&gt; </span><span style="color: #0000BB">padStrSingular </span><span style="color: #007700">( </span><span style="color: #0000BB">padStrPlural </span><span style="color: #007700">( </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$word </span><span style="color: #007700">) )<br>    ];<br><br></span><span style="color: #0000BB">?&gt;<br></span></code></pre> </td>

<h2>Random strings and UUIDs</h2>

<p><code>padStrRandom</code> draws letters and digits with <code>random_int</code>, PHP's
secure generator - good for a token or a code to mail. <code>padStrUuid</code> makes a UUID
as RFC 9562 writes it: version 4 is random; version 7 starts with the time, so ids made later
sort later and a database index on them stays in order. The example shows their shape, as
their value differs on every request.</p>







  
    <table border="1" cellpadding="10" cellspacing="0" class="pad-play-box">
  

  

    
      <tr>
        
          <th bgcolor="#dddddd">
            PHP
            
              <br>
              <font size="-2">fragments/strings_6.php</font>
            
          </th>
        
        
          <th bgcolor="#dddddd">
            HTML
            
              <br>
              <font size="-2">fragments/strings_6.pad</font>
            
          </th>
        
        
          <th bgcolor="#dddddd">
            Result
            
          </th>
        
      </tr>
    

    <tr>
      
        <td style="vertical-align:top"><pre><code style="color: #000000"><span style="color: #0000BB">&lt;?php<br><br>  $token </span><span style="color: #007700">= </span><span style="color: #0000BB">padStrRandom </span><span style="color: #007700">( </span><span style="color: #0000BB">32 </span><span style="color: #007700">);<br>  </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$first </span><span style="color: #007700">= </span><span style="color: #0000BB">padStrUuid </span><span style="color: #007700">( </span><span style="color: #0000BB">7 </span><span style="color: #007700">);<br>  </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$later </span><span style="color: #007700">= </span><span style="color: #0000BB">padStrUuid </span><span style="color: #007700">( </span><span style="color: #0000BB">7 </span><span style="color: #007700">);<br>  </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$id    </span><span style="color: #007700">= </span><span style="color: #0000BB">padStrUuid </span><span style="color: #007700">();<br><br>  </span><span style="color: #FF8000">// Random on every request: what is shown is their shape,<br>  // not their value.<br><br>  </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$tokenShape </span><span style="color: #007700">= </span><span style="color: #0000BB">preg_match </span><span style="color: #007700">( </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'/^[A-Za-z0-9]{32}$/'</span><span style="color: #007700">, </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$token </span><span style="color: #007700">)<br>              ? </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'32 letters and digits' </span><span style="color: #007700">: </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'wrong'</span><span style="color: #007700">;<br>  </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$shape      </span><span style="color: #007700">= </span><span style="color: #0000BB">preg_replace </span><span style="color: #007700">( </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'/[0-9a-f]/'</span><span style="color: #007700">, </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'x'</span><span style="color: #007700">, </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$id </span><span style="color: #007700">);<br>  </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$versions   </span><span style="color: #007700">= </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$id </span><span style="color: #007700">[</span><span style="color: #0000BB">14</span><span style="color: #007700">] . </span><span style="color: #DD0000">' and ' </span><span style="color: #007700">. </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$first </span><span style="color: #007700">[</span><span style="color: #0000BB">14</span><span style="color: #007700">];<br>  </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$ordered    </span><span style="color: #007700">= </span><span style="color: #0000BB">strcmp </span><span style="color: #007700">( </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$later</span><span style="color: #007700">, </span><span style="color: #0000BB">$first </span><span style="color: #007700">) &gt; </span><span style="color: #0000BB">0 </span><span style="color: #007700">? </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'yes' </span><span style="color: #007700">: </span><span style="color: #DD0000">'no'</span><span style="color: #007700">;<br><br></span><span style="color: #0000BB">?&gt;<br></span></code></pre> </td>
      
      
        <td style="vertical-align:top"><a class="pad-play" href="/pad/wasm/#" title="Try it in WASM" aria-label="Try this example in WASM"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="pad-icon pad-icon-play" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7Z"/></svg></a><a class="pad-play pad-live" href="/pad/live/#" title="Run it live, as a page of this server" aria-label="Run this example as a page of this server"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" class="pad-icon pad-icon-zap" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M13.5 2.5L5 13.5h6.5l-1 8 8.5-11h-6.5Z"/></svg></a><pre><code style="color: #000000">&lt;p&gt;token: <b>{<font color="green"><font color="red">$</font>tokenShape</font>}</b>&lt;/p&gt;<br>&lt;p&gt;uuid: <b>{<font color="green"><font color="red">$</font>shape</font>}</b>, versions <b>{<font color="green"><font color="red">$</font>versions</font>}</b>&lt;/p&gt;<br>&lt;p&gt;a later version 7 sorts after an earlier one: <b>{<font color="green"><font color="red">$</font>ordered</font>}</b>&lt;/p&gt;</code></pre></td>
      
      
        <td style="vertical-align:top">
  <p>token: 32 letters and digits</p>
<p>uuid: xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx, versions 4 and 7</p>
<p>a later version 7 sorts after an earlier one: yes</p>


</td>
      
    </tr>

<h2>Wrong input</h2>

<p><code>NULL</code> and <code>FALSE</code> are read as an empty text and a number as its
digits, so the functions take a database value as it comes. An array, a negative limit, an
unknown UUID version or an empty mask character is a mistake of the author: it is reported as
a PAD error naming the function, and the function answers an empty value.</p>
